name: blast-radius-whitelist
description: Blast Radius with a settings-based rm allowlist: holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) unless an rm is fully allowed by the rm rules in ~/.claude/settings.json (blastRadiusAllow when set, else permissions.allow).
